Welcome to Dine by Wix, the app where you can place orders, make reservations and get in contact with your favorite restaurants. With just a few taps of your finger, get everything you need to enjoy a delicious meal whenever and wherever you want it.  

SEAMLESS ORDERING
Easily access and browse the menu of your favorite restaurants and place an order for pickup or delivery. Once you submit your order, you can track your meal so you always know its status. If you’re pressed for time, you can beat the rush by placing your order in advance. 

SECURE PAYMENTS 
Conveniently make a payment directly through the app. You can use a debit or credit card, a 
third party app like PayPal, or pay in cash at the restaurant.  

TABLE RESERVATIONS
Place a reservation when you’re on the go so you can be sure that you have a place at the table. Once your table is confirmed, receive SMS and calendar notifications for your convenience. 

LIVE CHAT
Curious about opening hours, food ingredients, or just have a burning question? Open up a direct line of communication with the restaurant over the live chat feature. Chat on the go and enjoy top-notch customer service wherever you are.
